home.title: Import from Excel
home.subtitle: Bring your existing sheets into the app
home.intro: Move your school's Excel sheets into the app in one sitting. Use our templates or your own sheet: you'll match the columns and check every row before anything is saved.
home.safe: Importing the same file again is safe. Matching records are updated, never added twice.
home.orderBody: Parents and the schedule refer to people already in the app, so import in this order.
home.adminOnly: Only the school admin can import this.
home.noAccess: Imports are available to school admins and coordinators.
home.templateError: We couldn't share the template. Please try again.

staff.title: Staff
staff.body: Therapists, coordinators and admins, with mobile numbers and therapy types.

children.title: Children
children.body: Names, dates of birth and class or group.

parents.title: Parents
parents.body: Parents and guardians, linked to their children.

schedule.title: Recurring schedule
schedule.body: Weekly sessions: child, therapist, therapy type, days and time.

file.title: Choose your file
file.body: Excel (.xlsx or .xls) or CSV. We use the first sheet that has data.
file.tip: Your own column names are fine. You'll match them to ours in the next step.

errors.unreadable: We couldn't read this file. If it opens in Excel, save it again as .xlsx or “CSV UTF-8” and try once more.
errors.no_header: We couldn't find column names in the first rows. Put the column names in the first row and try again.
errors.no_rows: We found the column names but no rows under them.
errors.too_many_rows: This file is too big for one import (more than 3,000 rows). Split it into smaller files.
errors.unsupported_type: Please choose an Excel (.xlsx, .xls) or CSV file.
errors.password: This file is password-protected. Remove the password in Excel and try again.

match.title: Match your columns
match.body: We matched what we could. Check each one and change it if it's wrong.
match.missingSummary: Match the required columns to continue.

check.title: Check before importing
check.updateHint: Rows marked “Update” are already in the app. Their details will be updated, not duplicated.
check.showProblemsHint: Rows that need fixing or have a note
check.unresolvedBody: Pick the right match and we'll use it for every row with that name. No need to edit your file.
check.noSuggestion: No close match. Check the spelling in your file, or add them to the app first.
check.duplicateOf: Same as row {{row}}, so it will be imported once.
check.noProblems: No problems found. Everything is ready to import.
check.nothingToImport: Nothing to import yet. Fix the rows above and try again.
check.skipNote: Rows that need fixing will be skipped. Fix them in your file and import it again; nothing will be added twice.
check.emptyIgnored_one: {{count}} row without any of these columns was ignored.
check.emptyIgnored_other: {{count}} rows without any of these columns were ignored.

done.title: Import finished
done.safeAgain: Importing this file again will update these records instead of adding them twice.
done.failed: The import didn't finish. Nothing was lost. Please try again.

issues.phone_landline: “{{value}}” looks like a landline. A mobile number is needed to sign in with an SMS code.
issues.phone_foreign: “{{value}}” isn't an Indian (+91) number. Only Indian mobiles work for now.
issues.phone_shortened: Excel shortened this number to “{{value}}”. Format the column as Text, type the number again and re-import.
issues.phone_multiple: Two numbers in one cell. We used the first one.
issues.email_invalid: “{{value}}” isn't a valid email, so it was left out.
issues.date_invalid: “{{value}}” isn't a date we can read. Use day/month/year, like 14/03/2019.
issues.dob_future: Date of birth “{{value}}” is in the future.
issues.dob_unusual: This child would be {{age}} years old. Please check the date of birth.
issues.gender_unknown: “{{value}}” isn't a gender we recognise, so it was left out.
issues.child_same_name_exists: {{name}} (born {{date}}) is already in the app. This row has a different date of birth, so it will be added as a new child.
issues.role_unknown: “{{value}}” isn't a role. Use Therapist, Coordinator or School Admin.
issues.role_from_title: Role taken from the job title: {{role}}.
issues.role_defaulted: No role given, so they'll be added as {{role}}.
issues.therapist_no_types: No therapy types yet. You can add them later in People.
issues.therapy_type_unknown: We couldn't find the therapy type “{{value}}”.
issues.phone_belongs_to: This number belongs to {{name}} in the app. Their details will be updated.
issues.child_unknown: We couldn't find a child called “{{value}}”.
issues.child_ambiguous: More than one child is called “{{value}}”. Add the child's date of birth to tell them apart.
issues.child_dob_mismatch: A child called “{{value}}” is in the app, but with a different date of birth.
issues.child_dob_ignored: The child's date of birth “{{value}}” couldn't be read, so it was ignored.
issues.yesno_unknown: “{{value}}” isn't Yes or No, so it was ignored.
issues.therapist_unknown: We couldn't find a therapist called “{{value}}”.
issues.therapist_ambiguous: More than one therapist is called “{{value}}”. Use their mobile number instead.
issues.days_invalid: “{{value}}” isn't a list of days we can read. Try Mon/Wed/Fri.
issues.time_invalid: “{{value}}” isn't a time we can read. Try 10:30 AM.
issues.duration_invalid: “{{value}}” isn't a session length between 10 and 240 minutes.
issues.duration_defaulted: No duration given, so sessions will be {{minutes}} minutes.
issues.start_date_moved: The start date is in the past, so sessions will start from {{date}}.
issues.end_date_defaulted: No end date, so sessions run until {{date}} (end of the academic year).
issues.end_before_start: The end date {{date}} is before the start date.
issues.child_double_booked: This child already has a session at this time in row {{row}}.
issues.therapist_double_booked: This therapist already has a session at this time in row {{row}}.
